text:
Pearls are typically found in oysters.

To enrich the artistic concept of the urban life exhibition, the oyster can be reimagined through the lens of hip-hop. Just as the oyster layers nacre around an irritant to create a pearl, the city dweller layers experiences, struggles, and rhythms to form their identity. The "gritty atmosphere" of the city acts as the irritant, while the "characteristic beats and lyrical flow" of the hip-hop playlist serve as the rhythmic nacre, smoothing and transforming the harsh urban noise into something valuable and resonant. The pearl becomes a metaphor for the beauty and resilience cultivated within the relentless pace of city living, hidden within the rough exterior of daily survival.
